instructions_to_main_agent: Build a comprehensive SaaS multi-tenant platform for WhatsApp Waha bot reseller management. Support three distinct roles: Master Admin, Reseller, and End Client. Features include: Global reseller stats, client store management, plan quotas, WhatsApp Waha instance provisioning & QR pairing, catalog/product management, live connection status monitor, and clear status indicators for unconfigured external Waha nodes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Every interactive and key informational element MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Do not use transparent background in headers without blur.
Use clean modern Tailwind styling with high contrast and smooth micro-interactions.
Ensure all three roles have dedicated dashboards with intuitive navigation and live state polling.
